title: Iyyataa Mana Qulqullummaa
intro: Halkan sa’aatii tasgabbaa’aa ta’etti lubbuun of kennite tokko dallaa qulqullaa’aa iddoo qulqulluu tokkoo keessaa gara Rahmatamaan waamte. Waggootaaf amantii fi obsi hin raafamne dinqii gammachuu fi hambaa raajii fiduun badhaafamuuf ture.
clues: Guyyaa fi halkan koo bakka qulqulluu qulqulluu tokko keessatti of kennuudhaan dabarseera, yeroo hunda Gooftaa koo kadhachaa ture.
Ani dulloome, haati manaa koos dhaltuu turte, ta’us garuu rahmata Rabbii irraa abdii dhabee hin beeku.
Ilmi, Yahya jedhamu, raajii fi ibsaa qajeelummaa ta’e naaf kenname.
Ani mataan koo raajii, Ijoollee Israa'el akkan qajeelchu ergame ture.
Ani sanyii Raajii Haaruun waanan ta'eef Mana Qulqullummaa keessatti luba ta'ee tajaajilaa ture.
Maariyaam haadha Isaa kunuunsuuf imaanaa naaf kennamee dinqii isheen argeera.

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Qurxummii tokko jalaa baraaramanii gara ummata isaaniitti deebi'an

arabic: وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحْيَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَإِلْيَاسَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verse: And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias - and all were of the righteous. (6:85)
